issue.title: Report page only shows transactions from early January
issue.body:
Our "FY2026 all spend" report covers January to October, but the table on its
page only shows transactions from the first couple of weeks of January, newest
first. The CSV export has all 6,400 rows. Is the page meant to show only part of
a report, and if so, which part?

comment:
label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Yes, this is intended. The report page shows a preview, not the full report. GET /reports/:id in src/api/reports.ts loads only the first PREVIEW_ROWS (50) rows. They are ordered by date ascending, so you get the earliest 50 transactions, which for your report all fall in early January. The table then sorts those 50 rows newest first in the browser, so it looks as if the page shows the newest rows of a short range. The CSV and XLSX exports have no preview limit (up to 100,000 rows), which is why the export has all 6,400. For the full data, use the export. To see a later period on the page, narrow the report's from/to dates. Nothing is broken, so I'm not opening a pull request. If you'd like a "showing 50 of N" note or paging on the page, that would be a separate feature request.
